name: pseudo regeneration profile v1
purpose: Regenerate CAD-rendered pseudo scenes closer to real_depth_0626 shots without using real images for supervised training.

camera.resize_policy: keep aspect ratio and pad; do not squeeze to square
camera.view: vertical down-view with small pitch/roll/yaw perturbation

scene.placement_note: Tune camera distance/FOV/object placement until center-crop valid pixel ratio and bbox areas match real profile.

depth_output.invalid_background: NaN for pseudo source; training augmentation may simulate real raw uint16 0-invalid export

notes: Do not real-finetune for the main contribution path; use real labels for evaluation/diagnosis only.
If renderer can output directly at 480x848, also provide post-crop diagnostic PNGs for quick visual sanity check.
If the 480x848 render takes too long, keep 512x512 as an auxiliary ablation, not the main experiment.
